svg.text: DIAGRAM FROM THE PLAN DATA (shared/src/queens/compact.ts): every footprint, door and lane as checked. Not a screenshot; nothing is built.
408 x 408 m. Every v2 rule passes (the same checker). Black dots: front doors; white: second ways out (back doors, docks, goods gates). Zebras: crossings.
Washes: orange starter blocks, green mid, purple high-end, red landmark corners. Blue lanes: the back lanes and service ways (giant-wide).
